questions: Define Algorithm and discuss its key characteristics/properties.
Explain Asymptotic Notations: Big-O, Big-Omega, and Big-Theta with their mathematical inequalities and graphs.
Explain and compare Worst Case, Best Case, and Average Case complexities with suitable examples.
State and apply the Master Theorem to solve recurrence relations.
Write and analyze the Insertion Sort algorithm (including best and worst-case analysis).
Explain the Quick Sort algorithm, trace it with an example, and discuss its worst-case and best-case time complexity.
Explain the Merge Sort algorithm and solve its recurrence relation using the Master Theorem or Recurrence Tree.
Demonstrate the Binary Search method and derive its time complexity.
What is the Principle of Optimality? Explain its significance in Dynamic Programming.
Solve the Longest Common Subsequence (LCS) problem for given sequences using Dynamic Programming.
Explain and solve the Matrix Chain Multiplication problem to find the optimal parenthesization.
Solve the 0/1 Knapsack problem using the Dynamic Programming approach.
Give the characteristics of Greedy Algorithms and differentiate them from Dynamic Programming.
Explain and find the Minimum Spanning Tree (MST) using Prim’s and Kruskal’s algorithms.
Explain Huffman Coding and find the optimal Huffman code for a given set of frequencies.
Solve the Fractional Knapsack problem using the Greedy method.
Explain and differentiate between Breadth First Search (BFS) and Depth First Search (DFS) traversals.
What is an Articulation Point? Provide an algorithm or example to find it in a graph.
Explain the concept of Topological Sort and provide an example using a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG).
Explain the Backtracking method and provide a solution for the 4-Queens (or N-Queens) problem.
Explain the Naïve String Matching algorithm and its time complexity.
Explain the Rabin-Karp string matching algorithm and the concept of 'spurious hits' with a numerical example.
Define and differentiate between P, NP, NP-Complete, and NP-Hard problems.
Explain Polynomial Time Reduction and its role in proving NP-Completeness.
